amendment: The user corrected the MBP LAN endpoint from 192.168.0.2 to 192.168.0.12 before heavy execution began. The controller source bundle was then completed with all workspace path dependencies after a pre-search build failed closed. A 3.84M-node handcrafted launch found seven valid but depth-incomplete root rows; those artifacts are retained, common-incomplete parents are excluded without refill, and the attempt is counted in the ceiling. The first completed analysis exposed an omitted legalBestMove field in reduced sensitivity observations; its downstream artifacts are retained and regenerated after the serialization-only fix.

claimScope.sourceDisclosure: The parent source is the retained width-256 update-1920 versus handcrafted Step 3 development match. It reuses previously viewed development history and the same 64-opening suite; it is not sealed evidence.
claimScope.sourceIndependence: The retained match games were generated separately from the training and validation corpora. Exact raw-position non-overlap with those corpora is not asserted.

authorization.basis: User requested progress to Step 4, directed CPU-heavy compute to mbp, and subsequently corrected its endpoint to 192.168.0.12.

parents.construction: For each source game and phase, retain the legal pre-move position with minimum SHA-256 rank; within each phase take minimum-rank unique board states.
parents.classification: control iff handcrafted, C/16, and candidate 10k-node best moves all agree; disagreement otherwise
parents.selectionRank: sha256(haitaka-strength-first-step4-selection-v1 NUL || class || NUL || parent-id || NUL || sfen)
parents.rootIncompletePolicy: Retain and report every structurally valid root row; exclude parents lacking common completed 10k-node probes without quota refill. Exclude a selected parent if any union-source root probe is incomplete.

labels.scoreOrientation: Search each legal child with handcrafted evaluation, then negate the child-side-to-move score to the parent/root perspective.
labels.terminalHandling: Record terminal outcomes explicitly with root-oriented mate class and distance.
labels.incompletePolicy: Retain and report incomplete labels; compare only complete common-support choices; do not refill.

analysis.primary: restricted-candidate preference/regret over the fixed union, never exhaustive legal-move regret

execution.stopPolicy: Stop before scheduling work that would exceed either the node ceiling or 48 wall-hours; preserve completed immutable shards.
